name: polynomial division remainder as a check
mechanism: treat the data as a polynomial over a two-element field, divide by a fixed generator polynomial, and append the remainder; the receiver divides again and a nonzero remainder reveals corruption, with burst errors shorter than the generator degree always caught

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Cyclic redundancy check' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Error detection and correction:

requires: a generator polynomial (policy; decides which bursts are caught)
fails_when: errors that are multiples of the generator pass
